messages:
sam: kicking off a gradual canary bump to 5% in eu-west during the 02:00-03:00 change window. deploy-bot just started the job — need oncall + infra quick stop/go.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary rollout initiated -> model v2.3.1, change_id=chg_20260321_42. route: eu-west. logs: https://internal.corp/deploys/chg_20260321_42

maria: initial telemetry looks mostly fine but tail latency p95 up ~40ms on a small cohort.

ryan: any error spike? 502s / 5xxs?

maria: slight uptick on edge-3: 502s from 12->18/min over last 3m. overall error budget still OK but worth watching.

alex: recommend we HOLD for one more 5m sample. also request a pin on eu-west so subsequent quick fixes don't mix versions. disable burst autoscale for the canary group if possible.

sam: pinned eu-west routing to v2.3.1 for this rollout. deploy-bot: apply pin.

deploy-bot: [automated] regional pin applied -> eu-west pinned to v2.3.1 for change_id=chg_20260321_42.

ops_lead: seeing traces — KV cache warmup incomplete on some pods, which can amplify tail latency. I'd vote HOLD until caches warm or we see 502s drop.

sam: my vote = hold (temporary) :pause_button:

jen: I can +1 go if 502s stabilize to <5/min for 10m window, otherwise we roll back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot: https://metrics.corp/snapshots/chg_20260321_42 (last 5m -> 502s=16/min, p95=320ms, p50=78ms)

ops_lead: DECISION: HOLD. ops to prepare rollback playbook in 10m if no improvement. notify remediation and paging channels.

sam: acknowledged. I'll prepare rollback runbook and post the release notes delta to #release-notes.

maria: I'll kick off a quick eval against v2.2.9 for content regressions while we wait.

sam: thanks — ops, escalate if health degrades further. reconvene at +10m for a re-check and final stop/go.
